🎥🎬: Resident Evil (2026)

Bryan, a medical courier in Raccoon City, finds himself caught in a terrifying outbreak that turns an ordinary night into a fight for survival. What begins as a routine delivery quickly becomes a nightmare as the city descends into chaos and deadly creatures begin hunting him.

With nowhere safe to hide, Bryan is forced to navigate the infected streets while trying to complete his mission. Every step brings new dangers, limited resources, and increasingly horrifying encounters, pushing an ordinary man into a fight he was never prepared for.

As the night gets worse, Bryan discovers that surviving Raccoon City may require more than simply escaping the outbreak. He must keep moving, uncover what is happening around him, and make impossible choices while the nightmare closes in.

source_details.title: Resident Evil
source_details.synopsis: Resident Evil is a 2026 horror film directed by Zach Cregger and written by Cregger and Shay Hatten. It is the eighth live-action Resident Evil film, based on the Resident Evil video game franchise by Capcom. Austin Abrams stars as Bryan Hodukavich, a medical courier who encounters a zombie outbreak on his way to Raccoon City. Zach Cherry, Kali Reis, and Paul Walter Hauser feature in supporting roles. Constantin Film began planning a reboot of the Resident Evil film series in early 2022, following the failure of the previous reboot, Resident Evil: Welcome to Raccoon City (2021). Cregger was hired in January 2025, and Sony Interactive Entertainment's PlayStation Productions joined the product
